jobs.title: QA Automation Engineer
jobs.description: About the role We are looking for a QA Automation Engineer who can own and scale our quality engineering practices across RevRag AIs production AI products. You will work closely with engineering, product, and AI teams to build robust automated testing frameworks, identify edge cases, and ensure reliable product releases. This is a hands-on role where you will be involved across the entire testing lifecycle, from test strategy and automation to debugging, regression, and release validation. Key Responsibilities Design, build, and maintain scalable automated test frameworks for web applications, mobile applications, APIs, and backend services. Develop and maintain UI, API, integration, regression, and end-to-end automated test suites. Identify critical user journeys and convert them into reliable automated test cases. Create comprehensive test strategies, test plans, test cases, and automation coverage for new and existing features. Perform functional, integration, regression, smoke, sanity, and exploratory testing. Work closely with developers and product teams to identify, reproduce, debug, and resolve defects. Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and ensure tests run reliably as part of the release process. Analyze test failures, identify root causes, and distinguish between product defects, test issues, and environment issues. Build effective test data, mocks, stubs, and test environments where required. Establish and track key QA metrics such as automation coverage, defect leakage, failure rates, and release quality. Write clear, reproducible bug reports and manage them through a defect-tracking tool (Jira or similar). Continuously improve the automation framework, testing processes, and overall quality engineering practices. AI and Product-Specific Responsibilities Test AI-powered products and workflows, including AI agents and conversational systems. Validate AI behaviour across different scenarios, inputs, edge cases, and failure conditions. Build automated validation for AI responses, conversation flows, API behaviour, and system integrations. Test areas such as prompt behaviour, response consistency, intent handling, fallback mechanisms, latency, and failure recovery. Work with AI/ML teams to identify quality gaps and develop repeatable approaches for testing AI systems. Experience testing Voice AI or Conversational AI products will be highly valuable. Required Qualifications 2-5 years of experience in Software Testing / QA Automation. Strong hands-on experience with test automation frameworks. Strong programming/scripting skills in Python, Java, JavaScript, or TypeScript. Experience with UI automation tools such as Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, or similar. Strong experience with API testing and automation using tools/frameworks such as Postman, REST Assured, Pytest, or equivalent. Good understanding of HTTP, REST APIs, JSON, databases, SQL, and backend systems. Experience with Git, CI/CD pipelines, and debugging test failures. Strong understanding of QA methodologies, defect lifecycle, test design techniques, and software development lifecycle. Ability to independently own testing for a feature/product area and drive quality improvements. Good to Have Experience working on AI/ML, LLM, Voice AI, Conversational AI, or GenAI products. Experience testing LLM/AI agents, prompts, RAG systems, or model-driven workflows. Experience with performance, load, or reliability testing. Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure. Experience with Docker and modern DevOps workflows. Experience building QA automation frameworks from scratch. Familiarity with observability, logging, and monitoring tools. Familiarity with test management/tracking tools (TestRail, Zephyr, Jira, or similar). What Were Looking For Youre a great fit if you: Have strong ownership and attention to detail. Think beyond happy-path testing and actively look for edge cases and failure scenarios. Have strong debugging and problem-solving skills. Can work effectively in a fast-paced startup environment. Have a quality-first mindset with the ability to balance speed and reliability. Have strong communication and collaboration skills. Success in This Role Youll be successful if you: Stand up a stable automation framework covering the most critical user journeys and APIs within your first few months. Meaningfully reduce manual regression effort and time-to-release through automation coverage. Catch critical defects, including AI/agent behaviour issues, before they reach production. Become the go-to owner for release quality and sign-off across one or more product areas. Build repeatable, trusted approaches for testing AI and conversational workflows, in partnership with the AI/ML team. Why Join RevRag AI Work on production-grade AI products used by real customers. Get exposure to Voice AI, LLMs, AI agents, and modern automation systems. Work closely with engineering, product, and AI teams. High ownership and direct impact on product quality. Opportunity to build and shape the QA automation function as the company scales. About RevRag AI RevRag AI is a Bengaluru-based deep-tech startup building production-grade Voice AI and LLM-powered automation for customer-facing workflows. Our multilingual, in-app AI agents plug directly into BFSI journeys, improving digital onboarding, sales, and support while cutting operational cost by up to 70%. We work with leading BFSI organisations including Mahindra Finance, Motilal Oswal, PayTM Insurance, PhonePe, KreditBee, Razorpay, Udaan Capital, Kissht, PolicyBazaar, InsuranceDekho, Open Capital, and EaseBuzz. Disclaimer: This job posting has been aggregated from external source. Role details, content, and availability are subject to change. Applicants are advised to confirm the latest information directly on the company website before applying. 2-5 Yrs nan

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: Job Summary We're hiring a Data Engineer to own our data platform end to end: the pipelines that move data from MongoDB into ClickHouse, the accuracy of every number our customers see, and the performance and cost of ClickHouse itself. You'll work on our live production stack and use AI-assisted development (Claude Code) as part of your everyday workflow. You'll be the first responder when something in your area breaks, so you'll care about root causes, not restarts. Responsibilities 1. Data pipelines Run and improve the event flow from MongoDB through Kinesis, SQS and Lambda consumers, plus ClickPipes, into ClickHouse. Keep consumers healthy: retries, batch item failures, dedup, dead-letter queues, and Mongo and Redis connection limits. Fix failures quickly and find the root cause. A restart doesn't count as a fix. Keep dev, staging and prod schemas in sync, and handle DDL and schema initialisation safely. 2. Data accuracy and reconciliation Own reconciliation between MongoDB (source) and ClickHouse (reports) for orders, feedbacks, loyalty points, credits and comm reports. Investigate customer-reported mismatches (points balances, sales totals, undelivered counts, segment counts) and close each one with a root cause. Build checks that catch drift before customers do: daily row counts, sums and key metrics compared per brand. Get timezone, order_type and status handling right everywhere a metric is computed. 3. Moving to incremental processing Replace full recompute on every event with incremental updates, using ClickHouse materialized views and AggregatingMergeTree instead of repeated MongoDB aggregations. Ship migrations in small, switchable steps, each verified against the old path before cut-over. Retire legacy pipeline paths (Kinesis Lambda ClickHouse) once the replacements are proven correct. 4. ClickHouse optimisation Own schema design: ORDER BY, partition keys, granularity and engine choice, following ClickHouse best practices. Tune the slowest and most expensive queries weekly using system.query_log, and keep the ClickHouse Cloud bill within target. Prevent merge pressure: no forced whole-partition merges, sensible insert batching, healthy part counts. Make sure dashboard and export endpoints meet their latency targets. On-call: Each of these four areas carries its own on-call responsibility. When it breaks, you're the first responder. Must have Strong ClickHouse and analytical SQL (CTEs, window functions, argMax, joins) Production experience running SQS or Kinesis pipelines in Node.js Solid MongoDB experience (aggregations, indexes, change data) Hands-on use of Claude Code or a similar AI coding tool, with the discipline to verify AI output through tests and real data before shipping Nice to have CDC tools such as PeerDB or Debezium EMR Serverless or Spark Python for data checks Experience moving batch recompute to incremental processing Our stack AI-assisted development: Claude Code Pipelines: AWS SQS, Kinesis Data Streams, Lambda, Step Functions Analytics database: ClickHouse Cloud, ClickPipes (CDC) Source database: MongoDB (Mongoose) Compute and deploy: AWS ECS Fargate, Serverless Framework, EventBridge Scheduler, S3, SSM Caching and queues: Redis, Bull Language: Node.js (JavaScript) Observability: Datadog, AWS CloudWatch What success looks like Customer-reported data mismatches are rare, and when they happen they're closed with a root cause. Drift is caught by your checks before customers notice. Metrics run on incremental paths, and the old pipelines are retired. Dashboards and exports hit their latency targets, and the ClickHouse bill stays on target. Disclaimer: This job posting has been aggregated from external source. Role details, content, and availability are subject to change. Applicants are advised to confirm the latest information directly on the company website before applying. 2-4 Yrs Coding, Dashboards, Eventbridge, Data, Data Engineering, Customer Relationships, Customer relationship, AWS

The core responsibilities for the job include the following: Frontend Architecture / System Design: Design scalable, maintainable frontend architectures for complex web applications. Define application structure, module boundaries, and shared component strategies. Drive decisions around: Rendering models (SSR, SSG, ISR, CSR), Styling architecture, and State and data flow. Make informed trade-offs between: Runtime vs build-time styling, Global vs scoped styles, and Design system tokens vs local overrides. Build and maintain: Theming systems, Responsive and adaptive layouts, Cross-browser and cross-device compatibility. Ensure styling consistency and avoid CSS leakage and specificity issues. State Management: Architect complex state systems with clear separation of concerns: Server state vs. client state vs. UI state. Manage real-time and shared state across views and sessions. Prevent unnecessary re-renders and state coupling. Real-Time Communication: Build real-time features using WebSockets, Server-Sent Events (SSE), and WebRTC (where applicable). Design client-side subscription models, reconnection logic, and data consistency strategies. Coordinate real-time data flow with backend services and message brokers. Performance Engineering: Own frontend performance strategy across the stack: Code splitting and dynamic imports, Bundle size analysis and optimization, Rendering optimization and memoization, Virtualization for large lists. Optimize Core Web Vitals (LCP, CLS, INP). Use performance tooling (Lighthouse, Web Vitals, browser profilers). Security and Reliability: Implement frontend security best practices: XSS, CSRF, clickjacking mitigation, Secure auth flows (OAuth2 JWT, session-based), and Safe handling of tokens and secrets. Understand browser security, CORS, and content security policies (CSP). Ensure safe usage of third-party libraries and SDKs Libraries, Tooling Ecosystem. Expertise in build and tooling ecosystems: Webpack, Vite, Turbopack, Babel, ESLint, and Prettier. Testing libraries: Jest, Vitest, React Testing Library, Playwright / Cypress for E2E. DevOps Delivery: Work with CI/CD pipelines for frontend builds and deployments. Experience with CDN, caching strategies, and edge deployments. Collaborate with DevOps on observability: Error tracking (Sentry or similar), Frontend monitoring and logging. Technical Leadership: Own frontend technical standards and best practices. Mentor frontend engineers and review architectural designs. Collaborate closely with backend engineers and solution architects. Act as a frontend representative in cross-team architecture discussions. Requirements: Strong experience evaluating and integrating frontend libraries, including UI libraries (MUI, Ant Design, Chakra, Radix, Headless UI), Form libraries (React Hook Form, Formik), Validation libraries (Zod, Yup), and Data visualization (D3 Recharts, Chart.js ). Expert knowledge of React, TypeScript, and browser fundamentals. 10-15 Yrs Nextjs, React.js, Typescript, Front end, Javascript

jobs.title: Worksoft Automation Engineer
jobs.description: Title - Worksoft Automation Engineer Experience Required - 6+ Years Timezone - 4:30 PM - 1:30 AM IST Budget - 1.3 LPM Work Mode: Remote Profile: Experienced Worksoft Automation Engineer with hands-on SAP Certify expertise and S/4HANA upgrade testing experience Experience Band: 6+ years with 3+ years of hands-on Worksoft Certify experience in SAP environments WHAT YOU WILL DELIVER The client is running an SAP S/4HANA 2025 upgrade programme and needs an automation engineer to build and maintain a scalable regression suite covering critical end-to-end business processes. You will work across SAP GUI and Fiori applications, collaborating with functional teams, process owners and QA leadership throughout the upgrade lifecycle: Design, build and maintain automated test scripts using Worksoft Certify for SAP GUI transactions and SAP Fiori applications. Automate end-to-end business processes spanning S/4HANA modules and integrated applications. Create reusable automation components, process libraries, data-driven tests and standardised naming conventions. Prepare and manage test data required for automated execution across upgrade cycles. Execute smoke, functional, integration, regression and post-upgrade validation tests. Analyse execution results, investigate failures and distinguish application defects from script or test-data issues. Maintain automation scripts through system configuration changes, transports and release cycles. Document the automation framework, reusable components, execution procedures and support processes. Collaborate with SAP functional and technical teams to understand process changes, custom developments, interfaces and upgrade impacts. TECHNICAL CAPABILITY REQUIRED Worksoft Platform 3+ years hands-on Worksoft Certify experience in SAP environments - script design, maintenance and execution. Worksoft Execution Manager: batch and unattended execution, scheduling and result monitoring. Reusable processes and sub-processes: building modular, maintainable automation components and process libraries. Data-driven automation: parameterised test execution across multiple data sets and scenarios. Exception handling and recovery: designing robust scripts that handle SAP system behaviour variations. Automated process discovery or documentation capabilities within the Worksoft platform. Execution result analysis: interpreting pass/fail outcomes, identifying root causes and reporting defects accurately. SAP Testing Knowledge SAP GUI automation: scripting and maintaining automated tests for SAP ECC and S/4HANA transaction-based processes. SAP Fiori automation: automating Fiori launchpad applications and tile-based workflows within Worksoft Certify. Understanding of SAP roles, variants, workflows, background jobs, master data, transactional data and system integrations. Experience supporting at least one SAP S/4HANA implementation, migration or major upgrade programme. End-to-end business process testing across multiple SAP modules: P2P, O2C, R2R, PP or equivalent. Ability to interpret functional specifications, process flows, test cases and technical documentation. PLATFORM & TOOL COVERAGE Solid working knowledge expected across the following: Worksoft Certify Data-Driven Test Design Worksoft Execution Manager Reusable Process Libraries SAP GUI Automation SAP S/4HANA Upgrade Testing SAP Fiori Automation Regression Suite Management COLLABORATION & COMMUNICATION Comfortable working directly with SAP functional consultants, developers, business users and QA leadership. Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills to isolate defects from automation or data issues quickly. Clear documentation skills: framework guides, execution procedures and defect reports. Able to provide knowledge transfer and mentoring to internal QA team members where required. Disclaimer: This job posting and Location has been aggregated from external source. Role details, content, and availability are subject to change. Applicants are advised to confirm the latest information directly on the company website before applying. 6-11 Yrs SAP Module, Automation engineering, Integration, Order To Cash, Maintenance, Quality assurance, Business process, Exception Handling
